tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App and page background behind cards. Warm light gray. ink is 15.5:1 on it, ink-muted 4.9:1.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, top bar, inputs, modals, table body.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header row, idle dropzone fill, hovered table rows, code-ish keyword chips.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Soft 1px card borders, dividers, table row lines, gauge track. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, textarea and checkbox borders (3.6:1 on surface, meets the 3:1 control-boundary rule).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, icons, wordmark letters. 17:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, the muted words in the landing headline, '.me' in the full wordmark. 5.5:1 on surface, 4.9:1 on canvas.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, helper text, character counters on surface only (4.7:1). Do not use on canvas for body text.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons only (exempt from contrast). Never for readable copy.

tokens.name: orange-500
tokens.usage: THE brand orange. Wordmark 4th o, score gauge arc, active-nav indicator bar, focus ring, progress fills. Graphics only: 3.05:1 on white, never behind or as body text.

tokens.name: orange-600
tokens.usage: Primary button fill with on-accent text (4.7:1), text links, Critical tag fill. Same hue as orange-500, darkened for text contrast.

tokens.name: orange-700
tokens.usage: Primary button hover/pressed, orange text on orange-50 tint (5.9:1) in badges, usage pill when near the limit.

tokens.name: orange-100
tokens.usage: Borders of tinted badges, dropzone drag-over border tint, selected-row ring.

tokens.name: orange-50
tokens.usage: Tint fill: active nav item, High tag, Processing pill, dropzone drag-over fill. Pair with orange-700 text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on orange-600 or ink fills.

tokens.name: danger-600
tokens.usage: EXCEPTION to the one-accent rule (awaiting approval): validation errors, Failed pill text, destructive buttons, danger zone. 6.6:1 on surface. Never decorative.

tokens.name: danger-50
tokens.usage: Error banner and Failed pill fill; pair with danger-600 text (5.8:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline with 2px surface offset on every interactive element.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal and mobile-drawer backdrop.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Glass layers over the canvas or the warm blob only (usage pill, small popovers). Muted text holds 4.8:1 over the blob.

tokens.name: glass-fill-dense
tokens.usage: Glass that can float over anything, including the orange button: user menu, toasts, landing floating cards. Muted text holds 4.6:1 over orange-600.

tokens.name: glass-fill-solid
tokens.usage: Modals and the mobile drawer over the 40% scrim. Muted text holds 4.6:1 even over ink content.

tokens.name: glass-fill-near
tokens.usage: Near-limit usage pill (8+/10). orange-700 text on it holds 5.4:1.

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: 1px light border on every glass layer.

tokens.name: glass-blob
tokens.usage: Centre colour of the blurred warm shape behind glass layers (fades to transparent).

tokens.name: clay-primary-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the primary button gradient. Top stop is orange-600, so white text is at least 4.7:1 across the whole button.

tokens.name: clay-raised-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of raised surfaces (secondary buttons, tabs, pills, dropzone). Top stop is surface.

tokens.name: clay-raised-border
tokens.usage: 1px border on raised controls.

tokens.name: clay-card-border
tokens.usage: 1px border on clay cards.

tokens.name: clay-pressed
tokens.usage: Selected tab fill: pressed in. ink 14:1, ink-muted 4.6:1 on it.

tokens.name: clay-pressed-nav
tokens.usage: Active nav item fill: pressed in, with orange-700 text (5.5:1).

tokens.name: sunken-bg
tokens.usage: Input and textarea fill. Use ink-muted, not ink-subtle, for placeholders and counters on it (ink-subtle is 4.47:1).

tokens.name: disabled-bg
tokens.usage: Disabled button fill (flat, no lift).

tokens.name: danger-700
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the destructive button gradient. Top stop is danger-600.

tokens.name: blue-50
tokens.usage: Tint fill for in-progress and information: Processing pill, info banners (scanned PDF, busy queue). Pair with blue-700 text (5.9:1).

tokens.name: blue-100
tokens.usage: Border of blue tints.

tokens.name: blue-500
tokens.usage: Graphics only (3.97:1 on white): the active step ring, in-progress dots and bars, semantic match bars, the cool glass blob.

tokens.name: blue-600
tokens.usage: Blue text or icons on surface (5.2:1).

tokens.name: blue-700
tokens.usage: Blue text on blue-50.

tokens.name: olive-50
tokens.usage: Tint fill for done and positive: Done pill, matched keywords, strength markers. Pair with olive-700 text (6.9:1).

tokens.name: olive-100
tokens.usage: Border of olive tints.

tokens.name: olive-500
tokens.usage: Graphics only (3.78:1 on white): keyword coverage bars and dots.

tokens.name: olive-600
tokens.usage: Olive text or icons on surface (5.6:1): Connected, success toast icon.

tokens.name: olive-700
tokens.usage: Olive text on olive-50.

tokens.name: glass-blob-cool
tokens.usage: Centre colour of the cool blurred shape behind some glass layers (hero, sign-in panel, modals, drawer). Muted text on 72% glass over it stays 4.9:1.

families.sans: "Plus Jakarta Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero headline, desktop. Drops to display-lg on mobile.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Landing hero on mobile, dashboard greeting on desktop.

styles.name: score-num
styles.usage: Number inside the result gauge. Use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles, KPI labels in emphasis.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Upload your resume, paste the job, and see where you stand in under a minute.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your resume mentions PostgreSQL but not Redis.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Table primary cell, emphasized inline text.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: PDF, DOCX or TXT · up to 4 MB · about 5 pages
styles.usage: Helper text, metadata, pill text, table secondary cells.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Counters, timestamps, gauge captions. Minimum size for any text.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Sidebar group labels, KPI card eyebrows. Uppercase via CSS, ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap in pills, keyword chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between label and input, between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (small), list item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button padding, mobile page gutter, compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding, sidebar padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Default card padding, grid gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter, gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large card padding (primary Analyze card, result gauge card).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside long pages.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Landing section spacing on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Landing section spacing on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, textarea, small buttons, keyword chips, table row hover.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, dropzone, inner panels, sub-score cards, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Standard cards and KPI cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals, landing hero cards, floating score card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, usage counter, avatars, gauge, icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Clay cards (was 16 for flat cards; radius-lg is unchanged).

tokens.name: radius-card-xl
tokens.usage: Large clay cards: hero form, primary Analyze card, result score card (radius-xl is unchanged).

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Inputs and secondary buttons at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards on canvas (always with a border).

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, user menu, toasts, landing floating cards.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals only.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on buttons, inputs, tabs, rows (orange-500 outside a 2px surface gap).

tokens.name: shadow-clay-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button at rest: top highlight, bottom inner shadow, contact shadow and a wide warm shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-clay-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover, with a 1px lift.

tokens.name: shadow-clay-primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed: sinks, shows an inset shadow, moves down 1px.

tokens.name: shadow-clay-raised
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, icon buttons, unselected tabs, pills, the dropzone.

tokens.name: shadow-clay-raised-hover
tokens.usage: Raised control hover, with a 1px lift.

tokens.name: shadow-clay-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed-in surfaces: selected tab, active nav item, raised control while pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-clay-card
tokens.usage: Pillowy cards: inner highlight and a soft layered shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-clay-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons (Delete analysis, Delete account).

tokens.name: shadow-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs and text areas: inset, never raised.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Glass layers: top specular highlight plus a soft shadow.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, row action buttons, pills height 24-28 inside.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary CTAs, OAuth buttons, mobile tap targets (min 44px).

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Desktop app sidebar. Collapses to a drawer below 1024px.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: App top bar, desktop. 56px on mobile.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max content width inside the app canvas and landing sections.

tokens.name: wordmark-min
tokens.usage: Smallest allowed wordmark height (compact version). Full wordmark minimum is 24px.

depth.note: Composite values for the clay and glass recipes. Colours and shadows used inside them are separate tokens above.

tokens.name: clay-primary-gradient
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, about 6% lighter at the top.

tokens.name: clay-raised-gradient
tokens.usage: Raised control fill.

tokens.name: clay-card-gradient
tokens.usage: Clay card fill.

tokens.name: clay-danger-gradient
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter for every glass layer. Fallback without support: 96% white.

tokens.name: glass-blob-gradient
tokens.usage: Warm shape behind glass, blurred 28px. Hidden with prefers-reduced-transparency.

tokens.name: press-offset
tokens.usage: Pressed controls move down 1px; hover lifts 1px. None with prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: press-duration
tokens.usage: Transition for lift and press. None with prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: glass-blob-cool-gradient
tokens.usage: Cool shape behind glass, paired with the warm one. Hidden with prefers-reduced-transparency.
